原: three lectures or talks in section C. At the end of each conversation
疑为: 两句：…in section C. / At the end of each conversation…
理由: 一个句号后是另一句完整的话，切句时没有切开，两句连成了一条；译文照两句译。

原: three lectures or talks in section C. At the end of each conversation
疑为: 两句：…in section C. / At the end of each conversation…
理由: 同第 2 句（录音里这段说明念了两遍）。

原: really soar in the summer anyway, we’d probably save
疑为: really soar in the summer anyway, so we’d probably save
理由: 两个完整的句子用逗号连在一起；按“反正夏天贵，所以还能省钱”的意思译。

原: for when you’re stopped, this way you can still use
疑为: for when you’re stopped. This way you can still use
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，应在 stopped 后断句。

原: enough room for my mountain bike.
疑为: enough room for my mountain bike?
理由: 是一般疑问句，句末应为问号；译为问句。

原: I was deliberating whether I should ask for this, but now that we’re here, sure thing.
疑为: 女：I was deliberating whether I should ask for this. 男：Well, now that we’re here, sure thing.
理由: 前半句是女员工说自己犹豫要不要请假，后半句“sure thing”是经理同意；两个人的话被并成一句。译文用破折号分开两人的话。

原: than for men, the team suggests
疑为: than for men. The team suggests
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，应在 men 后断句；译文用分号分开。

原: transmit them real time to the institute
疑为: transmit them in real time to the institute
理由: 固定说法是 in real time（实时）；译作“实时发给研究所”。

原: concurrent with the decline in marriage, these two changes mean
疑为: concurrent with the decline in marriage. These two changes mean
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句；前半句 The first being… 本身也不完整，接上一句的 two new potential explanations。译文分成两句。

原: a boom in animal-free shoe. Collections, since they heard
疑为: a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard
理由: shoe collections（鞋履系列）被句号从中间切开，一句话分成了 173、174 两条；译文按一句的意思分两段译。

原: the result of various. Psychological biases that served
疑为: the result of various psychological biases that served
理由: various psychological biases 被句号从中间切开，一句话分成了 214、215 两条；译文按一句的意思分两段译。

原: whether these news stories threaten us or not, we conclude
疑为: …from across the globe. Whether these news stories threaten us or not, we conclude…
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句，应在 globe 后断句；译文按此意思译。
